mŏnarchĭa , ae,
			f., = μοναρχία, 
I.absolute rule,
				monarchy (post-class. for unius dominatio, imperium
			singulare, regnum, regalis potestas), Capitol. Max. and Balb. 14;
					Tert. adv. Prax. 14;
					Lact. 1, 5, 23.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
